newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares fall further in correction.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares fall further in correction.

text.p: Lithuanian shares fell further in moderate trade on Tuesday, dealers said.
The group A index fell by 116.00 points to 2,706.88. Overall central market volume was just over three million litas.

"The market is going through a correction right now. Shares rose a bit too quickly early this year," said one dealer, referring to the market's short-lived bull run at the start of the year that saw share prices soar.
Dealers said that more corrections could be expected over the next two months as final company results for 1996 are published.
"The results could have a big impact on the market, especially if they fall short of the market's expectations," said one dealer.
Blue chip falls on Tuesday included Hermis Bank, which saw its price fall by 9.96 percent to 211.50 litas in trade of 296.100 litas.
Lithuania Gas fell by ten percent to 2.07 litas in trade of 380,000 litas.
Bloc trades worth 258,000 litas were also made on Tuesday and the secondary T-bill market was inactive.
